note: Promotion to the tracked schema is out of scope: Regional's 83 themes each name a row at a single grade (K through 12, or the adult-route "9-12 . adult" for its seven industry-cluster themes), not a five-band ladder, so this fills description only through the unbanded mechanism (v0.97.0, prompt 3 continuation, the third pack reached after apply_promotions()'s grade filter was extended to GRADE_LEVEL in v0.95.0). Four cross-region themes ("Counting our region", "Skills that transfer", "Regional site rotation", "Regional economics") are repeated verbatim across 8 rows each -- one per named region -- since the theme text itself does not name a region; those rows correctly share one sentence, verified in tests/test_platform.py's per-theme (not per-row) distinctness check. track/code/level stay as they were (LB-<n> codes, level derived structurally by light_fill()).
